purpose: Disposable synthetic Castrol-branded demonstration catalog; these mappings are not lubricant substitution advice.
notes: Only the product-family identities are sourced. SKU identifiers, line distinctions, grades, pack combinations, dates, prices, costs, demand, stock and forecasts remain synthetic demonstration data; they are not an official Castrol India catalog or actual Castrol business data.
Indian official sources are used where available; global Castrol sources support other authentic families. Global references do not establish Indian distribution or current local availability.
Several source families map to one authentic target family. Keep unique synthetic SKU identifiers; do not invent extra Castrol product names to make the mapping one-to-one.
Mappings follow broad application category only and do not assert formulation, performance specification, OEM approval or technical interchangeability.
The conversion must use null mappings to exclude associated products and dependent serving data rather than rename unsupported merchandise.
The Castrol and Gulf brands must both be excluded from competitor-brand and competitor-product fields; an owned Castrol product in a comparison record is expected.
